# The Discord API in 2026.A webhook is all it takes to post.

To post in a Discord channel from code, the simplest route is a webhook: one URL from the channel's settings, no bot user, no auth header, and a POST of up to 2,000 characters and 10 embeds. A bot does more, reading and moderating, but needs an application, a token and an invite. Both are free; automating a personal account is forbidden.

Checked October 6, 2026. Breakreach is our product.

```
# The webhook URL is the credential: keep it secretcurl -X POST "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/$WEBHOOK_ID/$WEBHOOK_TOKEN?wait=true" \  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  -d '{    "content": "Morning Light is out. Honey, orange and cocoa notes, our lightest roast yet.",    "embeds": [{"image": {"url": "https://cdn.northbeam.coffee/launch.jpg"}}],    "allowed_mentions": {"parse": []}  }'
```

## The Discord API at a glanceWhat it takes before the first post.

PriceFree

WebhooksA URL per channel, created in its settings. No bot user and no auth header

BotsAn application, a bot token and an invite with Send Messages. Reading message content needs a privileged intent

Message2,000 characters, up to 10 embeds and 6,000 characters across them

Files20 MiB per file by default since August 2026; 25 MiB per request

Rate limit50 requests a second globally per bot; per-route limits in the X-RateLimit headers

Self-botsAutomating a personal account is forbidden and can end with the account terminated

SchedulingNone

Checked on October 6, 2026, from Discord's developer documentation and terms.

## How to get access to the Discord APIFrom a developer account to your first real post.

1. 1Create a webhookServer Settings → Integrations → Create Webhook, pick the channel and a name, then Copy Webhook URL. Through the API, it takes the Manage Webhooks permission.
2. 2Or create a botIn the Developer Portal, New Application, then the Bot page for the token, shown once.
3. 3Invite the botInstall it to a server with the **bot** scope and permissions such as Send Messages.
4. 4Turn on intents if you readMessage Content is privileged: you enable it on the Bot page, and verified apps, required past 100 servers, need it approved.

There's no review to post. Bots in 100 or more servers must be verified.

## How to post with the Discord APIThe requests in the demo above, one by one.

1. 1Execute the webhookPOST /api/webhooks/{id}/{token} with content, embeds, and an optional username and avatar_url. **?wait=true** returns the message; without it, Discord answers 204.
2. 2Or create a message as a botPOST /api/v10/channels/{channel.id}/messages with Authorization: Bot {token}.

Send a version, /api/v10: the unversioned default is still the deprecated v6. Files go as multipart with payload_json, and attachment://name puts one in an embed. A forum channel needs thread_id or thread_name.

## Common Discord API errorsWhat they mean and how to fix them.

| Error | What it means | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `404 / 10015 Unknown Webhook` | The webhook was deleted, or the URL is wrong. | Ask for a new URL, and stop retrying: repeated 404s get restricted. |
| `429` | A per-route or the global limit. | Wait retry_after seconds. |
| `400 / 50035 Invalid Form Body` | Over 2,000 characters, more than 10 embeds, or a bad field. | Check the lengths and the JSON. |
| `400 / 50006 Cannot send an empty message` | No content, embed or file. | Send at least one. |
| `413 / 40005 Request entity too large` | A file over 20 MiB, or a request over 25 MiB. | Compress it, or post a link. |
| `403 / 50013 Missing Permissions` | The bot lacks Send Messages or View Channel. | Fix the role or channel permissions. |

## Discord API limitsRate limits, text and media.

- MessagesContent up to 2,000 characters. Up to 10 embeds and 6,000 characters across them; an embed's description up to 4,096.
- Files20 MiB per file by default since August 2026, more with server boosts. 25 MiB per request.
- Rate limits50 requests a second globally per bot. Per-route limits aren't published, so read the X-RateLimit-* headers. 10,000 invalid requests in 10 minutes earns a temporary ban.
- Webhooks15 per channel and 1,000 per server. Names up to 80 characters, without "clyde" or "discord".

## Is the Discord API free?

Yes. Discord's API has no paid tier; higher global rate limits can be requested from its support.

What it asks for is care: a webhook URL is a credential, and a bot needs hosting, a token and, past 100 servers, verification.

## What the Discord API can't do

- Read messages, with a webhook
- Schedule
- Post outside the webhook's channel (its threads are fine)
- Crosspost to following servers: that's for bots
- Automate a personal account: self-bots are forbidden

## Post to Discord with Breakreach's APIOne request, scheduled, with retries.

POST /v1/posts

```
curl https://api.breakreach.com/v1/posts \  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BREAKREACH_API_KEY" \  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \  -d '{    "content": "Morning Light is out. Honey, orange and cocoa notes, our lightest roast yet.",    "accountIds": ["6701a2f4c9e84b0012a3b4d0"],    "media": ["https://cdn.northbeam.coffee/launch.jpg"],    "scheduledAt": "2026-10-07T09:00:00"  }'
```

What it posts on Discord

- Text postsUp to 2,000 characters, sent to the webhook's channel.
- ImagesUp to 4 images, shown as embeds under the text.
- VideoSent as a link, which Discord unfurls into a player.
- SchedulingscheduledAt in your workspace's timezone, the next free slot, or publishNow.

Not yet

- Reading messages
- Moderation and roles
- Stats

FAQ

## Questions, answered.

Short answers about the Discord API.

Yes. There's no paid tier; bots past 100 servers must be verified, and higher global rate limits can be requested from Discord's support.

To post announcements to one channel, a webhook: a URL, no bot user. To read messages, moderate or manage the server, a bot.

POST JSON with content (up to 2,000 characters) or embeds (up to 10) to the webhook URL. Add ?wait=true to get the created message back.

Discord doesn't publish per-route numbers: read X-RateLimit-Remaining and X-RateLimit-Reset, and wait retry_after on a 429. The global limit is 50 requests a second.

Put its URL in an embed's image, or upload the file as multipart with payload_json and reference it as attachment://name. Files are up to 20 MiB by default.

No: automating a normal user account, a self-bot, is forbidden and can get the account terminated. Use a webhook or a bot.
